# Vendored board.com theme

`board-theme.min.css` is a **verbatim, unmodified** copy of:

    https://www.board.com/wp-content/themes/board/assets/css/theme.min.css

| | |
|---|---|
| Fetched | 2026-08-13 |
| Bytes | 1268389 |
| SHA-256 | bdfe21bb798697e3c6f11bf51c89a1d47599b7a6c25b6288e29eb0980abafddc |
| Bundles | Bootstrap 5.1.0 |

`index.html` links the **live URL** by default so the prototype always renders
against the current production theme. Swap to this pinned copy by commenting
the live `<link>` and uncommenting the local one — useful offline, or to freeze
the theme while comparing changes.

Do not edit this file. All prototype rules belong in
`assets/css/boardai-overrides.css`.

Note: the copy originally supplied for this work (kept at `_ref/`) was 1,466
bytes behind the live file, so the live theme had moved on. Re-fetch and update
the table above when re-pinning.
